name: Sri Lanka

findings.summary: Ericsson agreed at MWC 2026 to supply Dialog Axiata's 5G radio access network, including 3.5GHz Massive MIMO radios, AI-driven RAN automation software and cloud-native infrastructure for network management, plus rollout and optimisation services, for nationwide 5G expansion.
findings.analyst_inference: Ericsson is Swedish, so third pole. Contract value not disclosed. Neither source says whether Ericsson replaces an incumbent RAN vendor or names Dialog's 4G/core suppliers; no exclusion of Huawei/ZTE is implied. Dialog Axiata is majority-owned by Malaysia's Axiata (operator, not controller under the equipment rule).

findings.summary: SLT-Mobitel completed the Sri Lankan landing of the 130Tbps SEA-ME-WE 6 submarine cable at Matara with US cable maker SubCom; commercial operation was expected by mid-2026.
findings.analyst_inference: Sources describe SubCom as collaborating on the landing rather than explicitly as the system supplier; coded us on that basis. Tier 4 (cable landed/construction) rather than 5 because commercial operation by mid-2026 was not confirmed in this pass. Sri Lankan investment value not stated. Whether HMN Tech was ever in contention for this system was not checked.

findings.summary: SLT-Mobitel trialled 5G-Advanced earlier in 2025 using ZTE radio equipment, before it and Dialog launched commercial 5G in December 2025 on 3.5GHz spectrum won at auction.
findings.analyst_inference: Tier 2 (trial). The source does not confirm ZTE supplies SLT-Mobitel's commercial 5G network; if it does, this would be a tier 3-5 PRC networks finding at the state-majority operator.

findings.controller: Government of India (grant funder; procurement limited to Indian firms on India-origin MOSIP platform)
findings.local_actor: Ministry of Digital Economy, Sri Lanka (SL-UDI)
findings.summary: India is funding Sri Lanka's Unique Digital Identity system, built on the MOSIP open-source platform; bidding was restricted to Indian firms, with TCS, Infosys and Protean under final evaluation in August 2026 and no award yet reported.
findings.analyst_inference: Coded third (India) because funding, the eligible vendor pool and the platform's origin are Indian; once live, the operator will be the Sri Lankan state and the pole could arguably become domestic (MOSIP is open source). Tier 2 pending a signed system-integrator award. Grant amounts differ across sources (Rs 10.4bn total grant in 2025 reporting; INR 3bn cited in August 2026); not coded as a value.

findings.summary: SLT says four to five parties are discussing data-centre operations with it and it has issued a request for information; AWS, Azure, Oracle, Alibaba and Huawei reportedly held talks with the government about AI data centres.
findings.analyst_inference: Pole null: no counterparty is named for SLT's own talks, and the hyperscaler talks with government span both US and PRC firms. Tier 1 (talks/RFI only). No Colombo Port City data-centre project was confirmed in this pass.

findings.summary: Sigiri.Ai, founded by Lasitha Gunasinghe, announced what it called the first Sinhala and native Tamil large language models; no availability, users or government role were described.
findings.analyst_inference: Coded domestic on the inference that Sigiri.Ai is a Sri Lankan firm (not stated in the source). Base model not disclosed. Tier 2 because deployment scale is unknown; scale municipal as a private small-scale launch with no government adoption.

silicon.null_reason: no accelerator purchases or deployments surfaced in data-centre and network searches; silicon not given a dedicated search

power.null_reason: no AI/data-centre-specific power project surfaced; reporting mentions electricity concessions/subsidy proposals for data centres only

research_gaps: Who supplies SLT-Mobitel's commercial 5G RAN and core (ZTE, Huawei or other), and Hutch Sri Lanka's network vendors?
Is Huawei an incumbent RAN/core vendor at Dialog that Ericsson is replacing or supplementing?
Was Lanka Government Cloud (ICTA) built or expanded by Huawei or other PRC vendors, and under what financing?
Do Sri Lanka Police or Colombo city CCTV/safe-city systems use Huawei, Hikvision or Dahua equipment? Only pre-2015 local reports with no named vendor surfaced.
Has SEA-ME-WE 6 entered commercial service in Sri Lanka, and does Sri Lanka host any PRC-built (HMN Tech) cable landing?
Which Indian firm wins the SL-UDI system-integrator award and on what terms; does India retain any operational access?
Any concrete Colombo Port City or other data-centre projects (controller, tier) beyond SLT's RFI and hyperscaler talks?
